title: Rav Huna son of Rav Idi
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Rosh Hashanah 24b, saying: “I heard it from Abaye’s lecture.” Seder HaDorot wrote that the reading should be Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua, as is implied in Avodah Zarah 42b; and Hyman says that there, at 43b, it became corrupted to Rav Yehudah son of Rav Yehoshua.

notes.text: Rosh Hashanah 24b names Rav Huna son of Rav Idi. Avodah Zarah 42b names Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua, and 43b names Rav Yehudah son of Rav Yehoshua. The proposed correction and the judgment of corruption are reported by Hyman.
